voice.name: Open Sector - Borg Drone
voice.description: A thin, flat, hollow chorus of many young androgynous voices speaking the same words in perfect unison, like a single drone of an alien cyborg hive: lighter and younger than a commander, emotionless and obedient, airy and slightly metallic with a faint electronic buzz and a hollow tube-like resonance, quick clipped machine cadence, no personality of its own.
voice.sample: Drone online. We are linked to the collective. Our carbine is charged. Give the directive and we comply. The hive speaks and the drone obeys. Matter will be taken.

fire.prompt: Single shot from a sci-fi energy pulse carbine: one sharp bright electric pulse crack, a quick laser blaster zap with a tiny sizzling energy tail, no gunpowder, no bullet, close, outdoors battlefield, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Steady rhythmic walking footsteps of a light robot soldier, left right left right, eight quick light metal footfalls on gravel spread evenly over two seconds with small servo whirs between steps, close, no music, no voice
